en.quote: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
en.riddle: Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
en.speaker: Jonathan

bonus_hint.quote: Therefore shall a man leave his father and his mother, and shall cleave unto his wife: and they shall be one flesh.

he.quote: וַיַּעַן יְהוֹנָתָן אֶת־שָׁאוּל אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו לָמָּה יוּמַת מֶה עָשָֽׂה
he.speaker: יְהוֹנָתָן

bonus_hint.quote: עַל־כֵּן יַֽעֲזָב־אִישׁ אֶת־אָבִיו וְאֶת־אִמּוֹ וְדָבַק בְּאִשְׁתּוֹ וְהָיוּ לְבָשָׂר אֶחָֽד

en.32: And Jonathan answered Saul his father, and said unto him, Wherefore shall he be slain? what hath he done?
